service.description: Read only: a bill's lines and their sources, checked against the organization's match policy. With an applied match, its allocations checked against the sources as they are now; else the allocations given, or the proposal: the bill line's existing billing links, else the approved order lines of the product from the supplier (orderId narrows them) on the policy's basis, the accepted receipts less what is in quarantine (held quantity; the inspection check itself is unavailable until there is an inspection record) and what other bills billed. Each source row has its snapshot, the quantity left to bill and its exceptions; a row beyond what its source allows names the refusal apply would give. Needs INVOICE_MATCH, PAYABLE_VIEW or ACCOUNTING_VIEW in the organization; refuses a customer invoice.

parameter.name: allocationList
parameter.description: Maps of invoiceItemSeqId, orderId, orderItemSeqId, assetReceiptId (optional) and quantity.

service.description: Match a bill: each allocation is checked again under lock (the organization, the bill, then its order lines in order) and refused when its source does not allow it: an order line not the organization's from the supplier, not approved or in another currency, another product, a receipt not of the line (SOURCE_INVALID), quantity already billed (ALREADY_BILLED), no accepted receipt on the received basis (MISSING_RECEIPT), or quantity beyond the tolerance (QUANTITY_EXCESS): what other bills billed of the order line (and of the receipt), what this bill's earlier allocations take of it, and this allocation together may not pass the base (accepted less held on the received basis, ordered on the ordered basis) plus the tolerance, the larger of the policy's percent of the base and its fixed quantity. It writes or updates each billing link (OrderItemBilling); a receipt with no invoice that the links now cover in full gets the bill line, as apply#InvoiceItemToOrder does. It records the match and its lines with the snapshot, the policy row and every exception code, and for an exception that holds by its policy (price outside tolerance, quantity not matched, no source, no receipt where one is required) places the match exception hold, naming the rule. Refuses a cancelled or paid bill and a bill already matched (MATCH_EXISTS). Needs INVOICE_MATCH in the organization. The same operationKey and request answers the first result.

Unapply a bill's applied match: each billing link it wrote goes back to its quantity before (zero when the match created it); a receipt that names the bill names another bill still linked to it with a quantity, even one that bills only part of it, so Mantle's receipt billing does not bill it again, or none when no link remains; the match is ended (ImUnapplied). A hold it placed stays until an approver releases it. Needs INVOICE_MATCH in the organization.

Mark the applied matches a change touches stale, for the re-evaluation job: the bill's (invoiceId), those with a line on a receipt (assetReceiptId) or on an order line (orderId, orderItemSeqId). Called by the AssetReceipt and InvoiceItem EECAs, so it only reads the match lines by index and writes nothing when none is found.

Evaluate one stale applied match again with the policy rows its lines applied, the bill locked before the match: a source that no longer allows its matched quantity is a source change, which holds the bill. Another exception that holds places the hold only when the match's lines did not record it, so a hold an approver released for a recorded exception is not placed again; the new exceptions are recorded. A legacy match holds only for a source change. The result is recorded and the match is no longer stale. A hold is never released here. For run#MatchReevaluation, in its own transaction.

The re-evaluation job: the stale applied matches, oldest first (up to limit), each evaluated in its own transaction (reevaluate#InvoiceMatch), with a named result per bill; a bill that fails is logged and the others go on. No hold is released.
The bills of the legacy backfill: an organization's bills with no applied match, from a supplier and a bill date range when given.

parameter.name: afterInvoiceId
parameter.description: Continue after this bill (bills are taken in invoice order).

service.description: Read only: for each product line of the bills, the link its evidence supports (its billing links, else its receipts), or why it is ambiguous (links or receipts of another party, product or order line, links over the line's quantity) or has no evidence; what the evidence does not explain is named and left unmatched. Needs INVOICE_MATCH in the organization.

Link the bills from their evidence, each in its own transaction (apply#LegacyMatch): a legacy match with a line for each link and each ambiguous line as a match exception line, every line with the policy row in effect; matched when every product line is linked in full, partly matched when a line has no evidence or a quantity its evidence does not explain, an exception when a line is ambiguous. No hold is placed and no unexplained balance is matched. A bill that fails is named and the others go on. Bills are read in invoice order a batch at a time, matched ones left out, so a run goes on past them; bills without evidence do not count toward limit, and lastInvoiceId is the last bill read, where the next run continues (afterInvoiceId). Needs INVOICE_MATCH in the organization.
One bill of apply#LegacyMatches, its evidence read again under lock. Needs INVOICE_MATCH in the organization.

actions.script: for (const field of ['invoiceId', 'invoiceMatchId', 'resultEnumId', 'resultText', 'linkCount']) context[field] = applied[field] ?? null

service.description: An organization's match policy rows in effect (with includeHistory Y also the ended ones), the organization's row and its category and product overrides, with names and tolerance texts, and whether the user may change them (ACCOUNTING_ADMIN) and run the legacy backfill (INVOICE_MATCH). Needs ACCOUNTING_ADMIN, INVOICE_MATCH, ACCOUNTING_VIEW or PAYABLE_VIEW in the organization.

Change an organization's match policy for its own row, a product category or a product: the row in effect for the same scope ends at fromDate (now by default) and the next starts there with the fields given and the others carried over (defaults: received basis, receipt required, no tolerance, hold); nothing changes when nothing differs. A bill line already matched keeps the row it applied. Which row applies to a bill line: the product's row, else the row of a category the product is in (of several, the one that started last), else the organization's row, else the defaults. selfBillingDefault is read only from the organization's row: a supplier's SupplierProfile change takes it when no profile row of the supplier is in effect at the change's date (store#SupplierProfile). Refuses both a product and a category, an unknown product, category, basis or action, a negative tolerance, a start before the row in effect and a start before a later row of the scope (POLICY_OVERLAP). Needs ACCOUNTING_ADMIN.

return.message: POLICY_SCOPE_INVALID: A row is for a product or for a category, not both

set.from: Array.from(scopeList).find((row) => Number(row.fromDate) <= Number(fromDate) && (!row.thruDate || Number(row.thruDate) > Number(fromDate))) ?? null

return.message: POLICY_OVERLAP: A row of this scope already starts later (${later.invoiceMatchPolicyId})
BASIS_INVALID: Choose the received or the ordered basis
ACTION_INVALID: Choose to hold the bill or to warn
INDICATOR_INVALID: Receipt required and self-billing default are Y or N
TOLERANCE_INVALID: A tolerance is not negative

set.from: current && Object.keys(values).every((field) => String(current[field] ?? '') == String(values[field] ?? '') || (current[field] != null && values[field] != null && toDecimal(current[field]).compare(values[field]) == 0))

return.message: DATE_INVALID: The change must start after the row in effect

service-call.name: create#mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceMatchPolicy
service-call.in-map: Object.assign({organizationPartyId:organizationPartyId, productId:productId, productCategoryId:productCategoryId, fromDate:fromDate, changeReason:changeReason, changedByUserId:ec.user.userId}, values)

service.description: End a category or product row of the match policy at thruDate (now by default), so the broader row applies from then. Refuses the organization's own row (change it with store#MatchPolicy), an ended row and an end before the row starts. Needs ACCOUNTING_ADMIN in the row's organization.

return.message: POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The policy row is not available
POLICY_SCOPE_INVALID: Change the organization's row; it does not end
POLICY_ENDED: The row has already ended
DATE_INVALID: The end must be after the row starts
